title: Print and plot the trained network expression
description: You inspect rounded parameter text beside predictions from stored weights.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You define r to round a value to six decimal places and convert it to float. The first report applies r to each parameter.
You assemble a printed equation from two weighted ReLU terms plus c. ReLU names the rectified linear unit used by the stored network.

steps.question: Does the plotted prediction use the rounded numbers in the equation string?
steps.answer: It uses the original parameter variables directly. Rounding affects the printed text, while the array calculation uses stored values.

steps.description: You evaluate the supplied inputs from zero to six and overlay actual data on the prediction curve. The printed equation in this recording ends with c.
